title: Cloudflare Worker deploy fails after upgrading the resend package to 6.9
symptoms: Build errors resolving stream, buffer, string_decoder or crypto
Worker deploy fails only after bumping resend
cause: resend 6.9.0 pulled in mailparser, which imports Node built-ins that the Workers runtime lacks without the compatibility flag. 6.9.2 removed the problem.
fix: Upgrade to resend 6.9.2 or later. If you must stay on 6.9.0 or 6.9.1, add compatibility_flags = ["nodejs_compat"] to wrangler.toml.
affected: resend (Node SDK) 6.9.0 and 6.9.1 on Cloudflare Workers, fixed in 6.9.2 (2026-02-10)
